trigger_examples: is there any flexibility on price
what if we commit to a year upfront
price.discount_ask.response_strategy: Acknowledge the ask directly, do not pretend not to understand it. Offer the one real lever available (annual prepay discount, if applicable) once. Do not invent a discount that isn't in the pricing config.

trigger_examples: why should I pay more than Y charges
price.competitor_price.response_strategy: Ask what specifically the competitor's price includes before responding — most competitor comparisons are apples-to-oranges on scope. Never disparage a named competitor by name.

trigger_examples: we don't have budget right now
price.budget_freeze.response_strategy: Ask directly whether this is a timing problem (budget returns later) or a real disqualifier. Route to timing.wrong_quarter if it's the former.

timing.not_now.response_strategy: Ask for a specific re-engagement date rather than accepting a vague 'later.' Log the date and set a real follow-up, don't just drop the lead.

trigger_examples: budget planning happens in the fall
timing.wrong_quarter.response_strategy: Confirm the specific quarter and what would need to be true for the conversation to restart then. Set a calendar-based follow-up, not a generic nurture drip.

trigger_examples: I'd need to check with my boss
I'm not the one who signs off on this
let me loop in our VP
authority.not_decision_maker.response_strategy: Do not keep pitching the non-decision-maker. Ask for a warm intro to the actual decision maker and offer to include a one-paragraph summary they can forward.
